title.purpose: Modal headings and rare top-level headings.

body.purpose: Controls, explanations, settings, and ordinary interface copy.

label.purpose: Section dividers and dense metadata labels.

mono.purpose: Paths, branches, hashes, line numbers, counts, and code-adjacent metadata.

shadows.name: field-lift
shadows.purpose: Keeps bordered inputs and outline controls tangible against nearby surfaces.

shadows.name: menu-lift
shadows.purpose: Separates dropdowns and context menus from dense repository content.

shadows.name: dialog-lift
shadows.purpose: Places a modal clearly above its dimmed application context.

shadows.name: tooltip-lift
shadows.purpose: Keeps compact help legible over detailed graphs and panes.

shadows.name: attention-ring
shadows.purpose: Briefly reveals a destination, tutorial target, or completed focus action.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, pressed, selection, and compact control feedback.

motion.name: overlay-enter
motion.purpose: Coordinates dialog backdrop fade with panel fade and scale.

motion.name: progress-reveal
motion.purpose: Expands progress details and failure explanations without a hard jump.

motion.name: wyrm-spring
motion.purpose: Branded tactile response when the Wyrm mark is clicked.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The clear action for completing the current step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--gw-accent); color: var(--gw-accent-fg); font: 600 14px/1.2 var(--gw-font-sans); transition: filter 150ms, transform 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { filter: brightness(0.88); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--gw-accent) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A tactile supporting action on panels and dialogs.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 32px; padding: 7px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--gw-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--gw-panel3); color: var(--gw-text); font: 600 13px/1.2 var(--gw-font-sans); transition: background 150ms, border-color 150ms, transform 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--gw-panel3) 82%, var(--gw-text)); border-color: var(--gw-muted); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--gw-panel); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--gw-accent) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Ghost Tool Button
components.description: A compact toolbar action that stays quiet until approached.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 30px; padding: 6px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--gw-sub); font: 500 13px/1.2 var(--gw-font-sans); transition: background 150ms, color 150ms, transform 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--gw-panel3); color: var(--gw-text); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: var(--gw-panel2); color: var(--gw-text); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--gw-accent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A compact editable field with a strong visible focus response.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 260px; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--gw-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--gw-bg); color: var(--gw-text); font: 450 14px/1.45 var(--gw-font-sans); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--gw-muted); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--gw-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--gw-accent) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Repository Tab
components.description: The persistent repository identity with an unmistakable active edge.
components.css: .ds-repo-tab { position: relative; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0; background: var(--gw-panel); color: var(--gw-sub); font: 600 11px/1 var(--gw-font-sans); letter-spacing: 0.04em; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-repo-tab:hover { background: var(--gw-panel3); color: var(--gw-text); } .ds-repo-tab:active { background: var(--gw-panel2); } .ds-repo-tab:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--gw-accent); } .ds-repo-tab-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--gw-accent); } .ds-repo-dot { display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-right: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--gw-accent); }

components.name: Branch Reference Chip
components.description: A compact branch marker attached directly to repository history.
components.css: .ds-ref-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; max-width: 110px; padding: 1px 6px; overflow: hidden; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--gw-accent); color: var(--gw-accent-fg); font: 600 11px/1.4 var(--font-mono); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; transition: filter 150ms, transform 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-ref-chip:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-ref-chip:active { filter: brightness(0.88); transform: translateY(0); } .ds-ref-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--gw-accent), 0 0 10px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--gw-accent) 45%, transparent); }

components.name: Selected Navigation Row
components.description: A dense side-panel destination whose selection never relies on tint alone.
components.css: .ds-nav-row { position: relative; display: flex; width: 240px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 7px 12px 7px 14px; border: 0; border-left: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--gw-sub); font: 500 12px/1.3 var(--gw-font-sans); text-align: left; transition: background 150ms, color 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: var(--gw-panel2); color: var(--gw-text); } .ds-nav-row:active { background: var(--gw-panel3); } .ds-nav-row:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--gw-accent); } .ds-nav-row-selected { border-left-color: var(--gw-accent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--gw-accent) 13%, transparent); color: var(--gw-text); } .ds-nav-count { color: var(--gw-muted); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Tool Surface Card
components.description: A flat-at-rest container for related repository information and actions.
components.html:
CHANGES
3 files ready

Review what changed before you commit.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 280px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--gw-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--gw-panel2); color: var(--gw-text); font: 450 13px/1.45 var(--gw-font-sans); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--gw-muted); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--gw-panel2) 88%, var(--gw-text)); } .ds-card:focus-within { border-color: var(--gw-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--gw-accent) 35%, transparent); } .ds-card-label { margin-bottom: 7px; color: var(--gw-sub); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.09em; } .ds-card strong { display: block; font-size: 13px; } .ds-card p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--gw-muted); font-size: 11px; }

narrative.overview:
GitWyrm combines the calm situational awareness of a control room with the approachable tactility of a personal workbench. The interface is compact, capable, and information-rich, but each tool has a clear place and every state change answers the user visibly. It should feel made by people who care about the work, not standardized by an enterprise committee.

Personality lives in precise details: the Wyrm mark, colored graph paths, direct language, responsive presses, purposeful motion, and occasional wit. Those moments sit inside a disciplined shell so the repository remains the focus. The system is professional without becoming sterile, friendly without becoming toy-like, and dense without becoming cryptic.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, theme-aware neutral surfaces with a restrained mint accent.
Compact desktop density with resizable working panes and persistent context.
Tactile controls with unmistakable hover, pressed, selected, pending, success, and failure states.
Color used for meaning: action, Git topology, change status, warnings, and connected services.
Small, deliberate moments of branded motion and wit inside an otherwise quiet workspace.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Paint Rule
rules.body: Deep Mint and semantic colors communicate action, state, or topology; they do not decorate empty space.

rules.name: The Selected Must Read Rule
rules.body: A selected control needs persistent contrast, an edge, a check, or another unmistakable marker. A faint tint alone is not a selected state.

rules.name: The Theme Contract Rule
rules.body: Components consume semantic variables, never a hard-coded theme surface, so every supported theme retains the same hierarchy and meaning.

rules.name: The Quiet Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Prefer weight, spacing, and text tone before increasing size; large type is exceptional in an operational desktop tool.

rules.name: The Micro Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing renders below the established 0.6875rem micro size, and microcopy keeps generous line height.

rules.name: The Persistent Context Rule
rules.body: Repository, branch, change count, current worktree, and operation state stay visible whenever they help prevent work in the wrong place.

rules.name: The Resizable Workbench Rule
rules.body: Fixed rails establish orientation, but working panes belong to the user and retain useful minimum and maximum widths.

rules.name: The Layer Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Raise an ordinary surface with tone first; use a shadow only when the element truly floats or needs temporary attention.

rules.name: The Radius Follows Scale Rule
rules.body: Small controls get small corners; large containers may be softer, but ordinary panels never become oversized floating capsules.

dos: Do make hover, pressed, selected, pending, success, and failure visually distinct.
Do preserve the layered neutral hierarchy and consume semantic theme variables.
Do use Deep Mint sparingly for primary action, focus, progress, and important selection.
Do keep repository context and operation state visible when an action could affect the wrong work.
Do use compact spacing and type while respecting the micro-type floor and user scaling controls.
Do allow small branded reactions and moments of wit when they reinforce a real action.
donts: Don't let any click, keypress, drag, or long-running action complete without a visible reaction.
Don't use a faint dark-on-dark tint as the only selected-state marker.
Don't decorate large areas with mint or graph colors; color must carry meaning.
Don't add shadows to ordinary resting panels when tonal layering already separates them.
Don't turn the interface into sterile enterprise software or a playful toy; keep capability and personality in balance.
Don't introduce oversized cards, inflated spacing, or mobile-style capsules into the dense desktop workspace.
